name: NUMBERS_TRUTH_STALE_ARTIFACT_20261110
comment: ANCHOR: NUMBERS_TRUTH_STALE_ARTIFACT_20261110 — LQ-20261107-1739. The 19:4x dry run's three pages were false
positives: each compared the CIO overnight-brief ARTIFACT (built before the XAR stop existed, on an older
release) with today's broker book, and XAR in fact had a working 229.33 x100 stop. A stop/coverage finding whose
shown side is a producer artifact older than the truth read is now marked stale_artifact by the audit; the
strike engine heals that producer FIRST (one run through the existing gateway heal path), then tickets it, and
never pages it. A rebuilt, fresh artifact whose mismatch survives is the page's own defect again and pages
normally. NT_UNPROTECTED truth excludes holdings the broker cannot carry a resting stop for — classified from
the row's own asset_type through scripts/lib/instrument_normalize.is_stopless_asset, never a symbol list.
The page-worthy event is broker truth: a held, stoppable position whose stop order expired at the close now
pages with 'your stop expired at the close (Day order)' and the order, price and quantity. Hermetic: synthetic
fixtures only, throwaway state roots, injected senders; the 1713 guard would raise on a real sender.
